summary: Interpreted the non-owner boundary receipt and corrected the alias ambiguity it exposed. Receipt c68b6de1442e45ffa00ddaf4df9b32e6 (fixed experiment 43b9bbefd939404e9ad77b1e71564e2d-experiment, 23 events) measured the boundary: with the accepting peers storing ballot 7, replica 1's attempt at its fixed ballot 6 produced no matching reply, dispatched nothing and emitted no follow-up (comparison 0 violated, witness 12), while replica 3's attempt at its fixed ballot 8 was joined by the peers, matched two replies and dispatched its phase-1 proposal - so the authority gate bites exactly when the recoverer's fixed ballot is below the stored one, which was previously only a sourced claim. The receipt's control comparison came back unknown because both round-start prerequisite aliases carried only the stored-ballot condition and so matched both rounds' events; the successor experiment requested here pins each alias to its round, with the harness and compared fields unchanged. The recovery-authority account now states the measured boundary for owner and non-owner recoverers, retains its counterevidence and limits (including that the above-ballot advance currently rests on parsed events pending the corrected comparison), and both supporting behaviors cite the boundary receipt's indices. Remaining unfinished work after this turn: reading that successor receipt and closing the pending comparison.
